verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents long-tap commit actions to Delete Commit, Edit Message, and Squash a commit with its child, plus Undo for unpushed commits and Amend for the latest commit. That covers most of interactive history rewriting, but nothing documents reordering commits, and editing is shown only for commit messages, not commit contents in the middle of history. missing for 10: commit reordering, editing contents of arbitrary past commits, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can interactively rewrite history by deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits

citations.quote: Long tapping commits you can Delete Commit to rewrite the branch without the work contributed by this single commit, Edit Message to change a commit message... or Squash a commit with its child.
For commits not yet pushed to a remote, swipe left to Undo them.
To make changes to the latest commit enable Amend at the top of the commit dialog.
